identity.name: Samir Elgammal
identity.title: System Broadcast & OB Engineer
identity.subtitle: CCU & EVS Replay Specialist
identity.tagline: System Broadcast and OB Engineer with more than 18 years of experience in OBs, broadcasting studios, playout engineering, CCU operator and EVS operator and guarantee. Specialized in sports studios with strong problem-solving skills and a creative approach to designing and implementing studio schematics and playout centers.

identity.statusText: AVAILABLE FOR UAE, GCC & INTERNATIONAL FLYAWAY

servicesSection.heading: Video production services
servicesSection.body: From focused personal projects to full-scale commercial productions, choose a level of creative support that fits your goals, timeline, and audience.

items.title: Basic video production
items.description: A straightforward production option for personal videos, social content, and concise visual stories. Get professional guidance and a refined final edit designed to make your message clear.

items.title: Business video production
items.description: Engaging corporate videos, promotional content, customer stories, and social media assets produced for your brand and audience.

items.title: Enterprise video production
items.description: Plan and deliver larger video initiatives with end-to-end creative support. This flexible option is built for organizations that need consistent, high-quality video at scale.

items.title: Professional video production
items.description: Elevate your project with a tailored production approach, from creative planning through filming and post-production. Ideal for polished campaigns, profiles, and branded content.

eventsSection.heading: Flagship productions,
eventsSection.body: Behind-the-scenes deep dives into major sporting leagues, global summits, and primetime entertainment across the UAE and GCC.

testimonials.quote: Samir is the definition of calm under extreme live television pressure. When our main fiber trunk was damaged 30 minutes before the presidential world address at COP28, Samir re-routed 6 CCU channels and our entire intercom matrix in under 8 minutes without a single frame dropped.
testimonials.author: Khaled Al-Mansouri

testimonials.quote: Desert racing in 45-degree heat and sandstorms destroys standard broadcast gear. Samir engineered an RF wireless tracking setup that maintained flawless 10km link margins for 7 consecutive days. He is our first call for any high-stakes mobile OB in the GCC.
testimonials.author: Markus Visser

testimonials.quote: In 15 years of directing UAE Pro League football, I have never seen a CCU engineer match 16 camera angles across shifting desert stadium floodlights with the precision Samir delivers. His EVS highlight packages are cued before the referee even blows the whistle.
testimonials.author: Tariq Ben Humaid

testimonialSection.ctaHeading: Ready to create a video that gets noticed?
testimonialSection.ctaBody: Tell Samir Elgammal about your idea, campaign, or upcoming project. Together, you can shape a video production approach that suits your objectives in Dubai and beyond.

faqSection.heading: Frequently asked
faqSection.body: Find helpful answers about the video production process, project planning, timelines, and working with Samir Elgammal in Dubai, United Arab Emirates.
